content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: INC-4021 triggered by service inference-serving - Severity: P2
pagerduty: Paging alex.k (primary on-call) - incident link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-4021
alex.k: I'm in a meeting, will try to join in 2m
priya.s: Can pick this up if you can't, ping me again in 90s
pagerduty: 120s passed without ack from alex.k -> Escalating to secondary: priya.s
priya.s: Acked. Looking at logs now. tl;dr: 5xx spike on /v1/generate in eu-west-1
jamie.ops: seeing errors in the gateway: "upstream reset by peer" across multiple replicas
priya.s: rolling a quick probe: `curl -sv https://inference.eu-west-1.redwood/probe || true` -> probes failing intermittently
oncall-bot: runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx
priya.s: scaling replicas up to 6 to mitigate backlog: `kubectl scale deploy/inference --replicas=6 -n prod-eu`
alex.k: joining now, switching to active
matt: paging manager due to potential customer impact (>10% errors) and no confirmed root cause
pagerduty: Escalated to manager matt - notified via email and call
alex.k: quick check of recent deploys: `git rev-parse --short HEAD` -> `b3f7a1e` (deployed 03:12 UTC)
jamie.ops: rollback candidate is `b3f7a1e`, previous good is `a9c4d2b` from yesterday
priya.s: logs snippet:
``
2026-03-15T03:40:12Z inference-server ERROR RequestHandler - KVCache miss for key seq: 0
2026-03-15T03:40:12Z inference-server ERROR OOM while allocating attention buffer
2026-03-15T03:40:13Z gateway WARN upstream reset by peer
```
priya.s: OOM-ish traces on some pods, may be memory regression in b3f7a1e (changed tokenizer cache behavior)
alex.k: initiating controlled rollback to a9c4d2b, will monitor
priya.s: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference --to-revision=2 -n prod-eu` -> started
oncall-bot: created incident bridge https://meet.redwood/bridge/INC-4021
matt: joining bridge, please post affected customers list
jamie.ops: customers affected (approx): 14% of EU traffic, high-impact: Acme Corp (timeouts), Boxley (increased latency)
alex.k: rollback progressing, new pods becoming ready
priya.s: once rollback stabilizes, we'll run canary traffic through healthcheck URL
pagerduty: Alert acknowledged by priya.s and marked as in progress
incident-bot: Incident note: mitigation in progress — rollback to previous release; scaling applied
alex.k: pods stabilized, 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 0.8% over 4m
matt: confirmed customer impact reduced, good job. Postmortem required. Assigning owner: priya.s
priya.s: next steps: add mem-sanity check to deploy, increase PD escalation timeout to 180s, add automated rollback in pipeline
jamie.ops: will open PR for automatic rollback based on pod OOM rate
alex.k: closing incident in PD after monitoring window
pagerduty: INC-4021 status: resolved
incident-bot: Closing notes: affected region EU; root cause suspected memory regression in token cache change; mitigations: rollback, scale up, bridge; owners: priya.s, jamie.ops; timeline posted to #postmortems
matt: thanks all — please add timeline and impact numbers to the postmortem doc
